summary: Grilled the FORGE-BOARD-4 plan (deterministic core of the upgrade split) across several design rounds and a constant-process reframing. Three mechanics maps grounded it: forge upgrade + doctor already handle machinery; the PM-state audit is the missing detector. Settled: a contract-driven audit that composes the harness's current validators (auto-reflects future changes), an honest evidence-based backfill, wiring into the existing harness-health cadence, and closing D-0011 here.
contradictions: The instinct to 'reconstruct details for done stories' collides with docs/specs/project-record.md's mark-don't-fabricate rule (no outcome written after the fact; nothing invents history).
resolutions: Split into the deterministic core (this story) and the skill (FORGE-BOARD-5); the core unblocks D-0011 fast and is CI-testable.

Honest boundary: recover facts (pr-link from real GitHub merge records) and reconstruct card fields ONLY from committed evidence; ZERO-match -> predates marker, TWO+-ambiguous -> report+skip; never synthesize outcomes/ACs for shipped work.

Constant process: the audit is contract-driven (composes check_board_complete / check_story_contract / check_vendor_integrity), so a new harness requirement is detected with no audit change; it rides harness-health.yml's existing cadence. Detection automatic; application human-gated.
D-0011 is closed IN this story (4.3 runs the backfill here + enables board-invariant on main).
